verifications.claim: Hulu has renewed the Sterling K. Brown-led drama Paradise for a third and final season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Paradise has been renewed for a third season, which will likely be its last.'; R3: 'Hulu renewed Paradise for Season 3.'; R4: 'Hulu announced that Paradise will return for season 3'; R7: 'Hulu has renewed Paradise... for a third season.'; R1: 'We know what the end is, and it’s an end that would make it very difficult to make a season four.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Hulu's renewal for season 3; creator intent and producer statements clearly indicate it as the final season, directly supporting the claim.

verifications.claim: Filming for Paradise season 3 is expected to begin in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'the season begins filming in April 2026.'; R4: 'Paradise would start filming season 3 in mid-April 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements from Fogelman in R2 and R4 confirm filming starts in April 2026.

verifications.claim: Paradise season 3 has a potential early 2027 release.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'we could get new episodes in 2027.'; R4: 'Paradise season 3 to arrive in January 2027.'; R10: 'Paradise season 3 might arrive sometime in early 2027.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly speculate or project an early 2027 release based on production timelines.

verifications.claim: Dan Fogelman is the creator of Paradise.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Dan Fogelman‘s hit Hulu series'; R2: 'creator Dan Fogelman'; R3: 'creator Dan Fogelman'; etc.
verifications.reasoning: All major sources explicitly identify Dan Fogelman as the creator.

verifications.claim: Dan Fogelman designed Paradise with a strict three-season arc.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Fogelman... set out to make Paradise with a clear three-season vision'; R4: 'Fogelman has been clear that he had a three-season plan'; R9: 'definitive three-season arc mapped out'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state Fogelman's three-season vision or plan from the start.

verifications.claim: Paradise season 3 will conclude the story.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'season three... that will close out this story'; R4: 'end that would make it very difficult to make a season four'; R6: 'three seasons is all he’s ever planned for the show'
verifications.reasoning: Producers and creator confirm season 3 is designed to end the story.

verifications.claim: Hulu officially renewed Paradise season 3 on March 17, 2026 ahead of the season 2 finale according to Deadline.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'On March 17, ahead of Season 2’s final two episodes, Hulu renewed'; R7 (Deadline): 'ahead of the Season 2 finale on March 30'; R4: 'On March 17, 2026, Hulu announced'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources, including Deadline (R7), confirm the exact date and timing ahead of the finale.

verifications.claim: Entertainment Weekly suggests a 2027 release for Paradise season 3.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2 (EW): 'hopes season 3 can arrive "even quicker" than season 2's 13 months after season 1' (no mention of 2027).
verifications.reasoning: EW (R2) discusses quicker release but does not suggest or mention 2027 specifically; claim misattributes.

verifications.claim: Filming for Paradise season 3 is expected to run from roughly April 2026 through August 2026 according to details mentioned by Sterling K. Brown to People.com.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R5 (People): 'Brown said he believed they'd be behind the camera from March to August 2026, per his podcast, That Was Us.'
verifications.reasoning: People (R5) attributes to Brown via podcast (not directly to People), and dates are March-August, not April-August.

verifications.claim: Dan Fogelman indicated that Paradise was designed to be a three-season plan similar to This Is Us.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'with This Is Us, he knew it was going to be six seasons... [With] Paradise, he knows it's three seasons.'; R1: 'Fogelman, who famously created This Is Us, set out to make Paradise with a clear three-season vision'
verifications.reasoning: Sources link Fogelman's planning for Paradise's three seasons directly to his This Is Us approach.

verifications.claim: Sterling K. Brown is set to return for Paradise season 3.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'you can expect much of the main cast to return'; R4: 'Most of the main cast will likely return, including Sterling K. Brown'; R5: 'continue to star Brown'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm lead Sterling K. Brown returns as protagonist.

verifications.claim: Julianne Nicholson is expected to return for Paradise season 3.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'the chance she could resurface in the present (or future?) as part of Alex's time manipulation'; R4: 'Likely... Julianne Nicholson... will return in at least one flashback'
verifications.reasoning: Sources expect return via flashbacks or time manipulation, but not confirmed as present-day role.

verifications.claim: Sarah Shahi is expected to return for Paradise season 3.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Most of the main cast will likely return, including... Sarah Shahi (Dr. Gabriela Torabi)'; R7: 'Season 2 stars Brown, Nicholson... Sarah Shahi'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly listed in main cast expected to return; no death confirmed.
